name: Free Drum Samples (Boochi44)
author: Boochi44
description: Three curated drum kits for hip-hop and trap production: Hard Trap, Bounce, and Soulful Vintage. Includes kicks, 808s, snares, claps, hi-hats, percussion, and effects.
notes: Contains three curated drum kits. Some samples use Edward Loveall's CC0 TR-808 set; others are synthesized. Soulful Vintage uses down-sampling and bit-crushing. No attribution is required under the CC0 license.
